en: Self-hosted runner: Added `CLAUDE_RUNNER_SPAWN_REASON` to the orchestrator's spawn-runner hook environment: why Anthropic sent the request (e.g. `runner_lost`, `resumed`); unset when none was sent
zh: 自托管运行器：在编排器的 spawn-runner hook 环境中新增 `CLAUDE_RUNNER_SPAWN_REASON`，说明 Anthropic 发送请求的原因（如 `runner_lost`、`resumed`）；未发送原因时不设置
